up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1741220 (Bromodomain adjacent to zinc finger domain protein 2B). For each activity return: the assay ChEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), the target type (target_dictionary.target_type), the tax_id (target_dictionary.tax_id), the canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), the molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), the standard type (activities.standard_type), and the pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Filter to rows where: activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_units = 'nM' (or null), activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.pchembl_value is not null, assays.assay_type is not null, the target is a single-protein target with CHEMBL ID exactly 'CHEMBL1741220', and the organism is human (target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606). Join assays to target_dictionary via assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid, join to compound_structures via activities.molecule_chembl_id = compound_structures.molecule_chembl_id, and join to molecule_dictionary via activities.molecule_chembl_id = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Order the final result set by molecule ChEMBL ID (ascending) then assay ChEMBL ID (ascending). Do not filter by assay source, document type, or any additional constraints beyond those specified.
sql:
SELECT a.assay_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molregno
WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
  AND td.tid IN (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741220' AND tax_id = 9606)
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
